reason: Acceptance criteria and out-of-scope boundaries for checking the CI fix.
Verify deterministic mock UI e2e still uses Xvfb, real UI interaction, isolated app data, and sanitized diagnostics.
Verify credential/keychain handling remains secret-safe and does not introduce bypasses or leaked API keys.
Verify settings and credential save path remains renderer UI -> preload IPC -> main/keychain.
Verify runtime environment changes do not violate Electron dev/test isolation.
Verify TypeScript standards if scripts/tests changed.
